Dialogue.Page: Thank goodness you're here! I thought since you were taking your first flight today, I could show you this strange anomaly I've found!
This massive star system near the core of our galaxy has gone supernova, and collapsed into the most powerful black hole us Hearthians have ever seen.
*ahem* Sorry, I'll stop yapping about. Go on, take a look! You might even catch a signal on your Signalscope!
That black hole's quite a specticale, isn't it? If only I could study it up close.
The telescope also picked up a signal of it. You should be able to pick it up with your Signalscope.
Don't spend too long there, though! I want to keep studying this fascinating system.
Hollow's Lantern? I didn't even think there was anything on that molten rock!
Nah, it doesn't matter all that much. We'll take any new information we can find, right?

DialogueOption.Text: It told me that Black Hole Warp Cores break out and expand when exposed to heat, causing the weilder to warp.

Dialogue.Page: Extreme heat causes the Black Hole Warp Core to expand and warps all in its path...
If you think what you discovered is worthwhile, go ahead and try it out! Don't say I didn't warn you, though.

DialogueOption.Text: Nope. I used a heat-exposed Nomai Warp Core to get there.

Dialogue.Page: Of course! Extreme heat causes the Black Hole Warp Core to expand and warps all in its path. It all makes sense!
You are one lucky Hearthian! I wish I could go with you.

DialogueOption.Text: Hmmm.... Probably not the best idea.

Dialogue.Page: How so? Is the black hole too dangerous?

DialogueOption.Text: Because the universe is d- Nevermind.

Dialogue.Page: The universe is dangerous? Indeed it is. Maybe it's better I admire it from afar.
I'd like to know more about what you find! Safe travels!
